digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI matrix and coverage collection
propositions: Coverage instrumentation (--cov=rebar --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered) is collected identically on three Ubuntu Python cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13) without corresponding source-code version branches, creating duplicate measurement overhead.

A-B-B-A-A-B experiment measured local_delta=34s wall time per uninstrumented cell, confirming coverage tracing adds measurable runner occupancy without additional test/assertion/OS/Python/behavioral coverage.

Ubuntu Python 3.13 (newest stable paired with sole macOS cell) should be designated the sole coverage-collection cell while Python 3.11 and 3.12 retain all tests uninstrumented, following the ropeable-hydrated-siskin precedent.
OSS consensus survey (Django, NumPy, SciPy) confirms selective coverage collection on a primary or dedicated configuration is the current practice, with no documented rejection of that topology.

Workflow contract tests must verify exactly Ubuntu 3.13 receives both coverage flags and the empty string only in the final or-slot, while all other cells (3.11, 3.12, macOS) receive no coverage flags, with all four cells retaining both default and integration pytest tiers.

Pre-merge Verify baseline run 31798375024 (31m19s wall clock) and Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 default-suite durations (599s/642s) must be recorded; post-merge observation (first run with merged workflow) is delegated to inedible-subsimious-brahmancow to measure runner-seconds freed via delta comparison on 3.11 and 3.12 only.
